questions.q: Which chords make a perfect cadence?
questions.why: A perfect cadence is V to I.

questions.q: What is a Tierce de Picardie?
options: A minor piece ending on a major chord
A key change to the dominant
questions.why: It is a major tonic chord at the end of a minor-key section.

questions.q: A piece in C major moves to G major. This is a ___.
questions.why: A change of key is a modulation; G is the dominant key.

questions.q: Describe the effect of an imperfect cadence.
questions.model: It ends on chord V and sounds unfinished, like a comma or question.
